findings.text: The renamed and reparameterised test_directory_claims_share_their_files_under_a_shared_root keeps the ("pkg","pkg") case, now expecting admission, but the implementation still refuses two identical claims on an existing directory: _SharedWritePaths.__contains__ returns False for any path where the resolved path is a directory (reckon/crew/runs.py:1652), so _claim_paths_share(shared,"pkg","pkg") is False and _dispatch still raises ScopeConflict. Probed at the reviewed head in a scratch extraction: the file-under-directory pair returns True while the directory-under-directory pair returns False. The assertion is unexercised in the gate because all twelve tests in this file abort at dispatch.py:3436 with 'codex inbox hook trust could not be established by hooks/list' in both arms, so the failing parametrisation never reached its assert. Either the predicate must share two identical claims on a directory under a shared root, or that parametrisation must return to expecting a refusal.

The _shared_write_paths docstring still ends 'Directory claims remain exclusive.', which the landed change contradicts; the file the node edited now documents the superseded rule beside the code that implements the new one.

The change to _live_conflict_rows (the dispatch conflict report) has no assertion in either test file: the new tests exercise queue admission through _live_claim_hold and the launch refusal through _raise_repository_scope_conflict, so a regression in this third site would leave both tests green.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Production call sites examined: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1226 _claim_collision, reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:1558 _live_conflict_rows and :2193 _raise_repository_scope_conflict; all three pass shared_files from runs._shared_write_paths, which returns _SharedWritePaths, so the isinstance guard never silently disables the rule.

item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to reproduce the 11 November hold of a queued request on a shared-root file claim and make such an overlap admit whatever the holder's phase; reckon/crew/runs.py:1693 _claim_paths_share now admits the reproduced file-under-directory pair at both comparison sites, verified by probing the predicate at the reviewed head.
